results.prompt: at the end of the cycle, re-place the graspable at the start position

response.message:
The pick-and-place cycle now has the complete sequence to re-place the graspable at the start position. Here's what was added:

**Added nodes after `detach_graspable` and before `return_rest`:**

1. **`move_to_graspable_start`** - Moves the arm to position the graspable at a start location (position [0, 0, 0.1] relative to base frame)

2. **`reattach_graspable`** - Re-attaches the graspable to the gripper TCP so it moves with the robot

3. **`open_gripper_after_return`** - Opens the gripper to release the graspable at the start position

4. **`detach_graspable_again`** - Detaches the graspable from the gripper

5. **`move_graspable_to_start`** - Moves the graspable to the start position using its scene resource reference

6. **`return_rest`** - Returns the robot to its rest joint configuration

The complete flow now: picks up the graspable → places it down → moves to start position → re-attaches → opens gripper → detaches → moves graspable to start position → returns to rest.

This ensures the graspable is properly returned to its start position at the end of each pick-and-place cycle.

entries.name: Command gripper position
entries.description: Commands a gripper to a numeric position or to its open or closed preset and waits for the command to complete. A pneumatic gripper instead writes its valve outputs, confirms its required inputs and holds for its dwell, and a Close that requires grasp evidence fails when no evidence is found.

parameters.description: Gripper component and command target to command.
Target as an angular (radians) or linear (meters) position for the gripper kind, or the named open or closed preset.
Effort limit in newton-meters or newtons, sent only to a controller that exposes an effort interface; omitted sends no limit.
Command duration in seconds; omitted uses the configured duration of a pneumatic gripper and 0 for other grippers.
When true, a completed command is held until command_duration_s has elapsed; omitted or false completes on the controller result.
Input levels to confirm after a pneumatic gripper's valve outputs, at most four, each a declared input of that gripper; ignored by other grippers.
Whether the pneumatic dwell keeps running while an operator Stop holds the node: pause stops it, count keeps it running.
Positive seconds the command may take to complete; omitted uses 30.0.

entries.name: Wait for gripper status
entries.description: Waits until the captured gripper command reaches expected_state. Fails on timeout, when the command or its source is replaced or unavailable, or when the command reports failed.

parameters.description: Gripper component and command target whose command is observed.
Command state to wait for: idle, moving (executing), reached (completed) or failed.
Program-time seconds before the wait fails, from 0.01 to 3600; a Halt pauses this time.
Whether time held by an operator Stop counts toward timeout_s: pause excludes it, count includes it.

coordinate_effort_limit.description: An effort limit for one coordinate: a torque in newton-meters for an angular coordinate or a force in newtons for a linear one. The kind decides which unit field is used.

kind.description: angular_newton_meter uses value_nm; linear_newton uses value_n.

value_n.description: Force limit in newtons, 0 or more; used only for kind linear_newton.

value_nm.description: Torque limit in newton-meters, 0 or more; used only for kind angular_newton_meter.

coordinate_position.description: A single coordinate position: an angle in radians, a linear position in meters, or a named preset. The kind decides which one field is used.

kind.description: angular_rad uses value_rad, linear_m uses value_m, named_preset uses name.

name.description: Preset name, open or closed; used only for kind named_preset.

value_m.description: Linear position in meters; used only for kind linear_m.

value_rad.description: Angle in radians; used only for kind angular_rad.

target_reference.description: Names one command target of a controllable component by component id and command target id.

command_target_id.description: Command target identifier within the component.
